name: WPMozo Product Grid for WooCommerce
author: Elicus

sections.description:
WPMozo Product Grid for WooCommerce

WPMozo Gutenberg Product Grid for WooCommerce is a WordPress plugin for creating products grid. This plugin allows store owners to showcase their products in a responsive and customizable layout within the Gutenberg editor.

View Demo

Key Features of the WPMozo Product Grid for WooCommerce Plugin

Gutenberg Block

The WPMozo Gutenberg product grid for WooCommerce is a dedicated Gutenberg block that helps WordPress users create flexible and engaging product displays. After installation and activation, users can easily find and use a dedicated block within the editor to create beautiful product grids.

Adaptable Display

Access various options to customize grid columns, spacing, pagination styles, and more.

Optimized for all products

Works seamlessly for all products types.

Mobile-Responsive Design:

The WPMozo Product Grid for WooCommerce ensures your products look great and work perfectly on all devices.

For new feature suggestions, kindly reach out via our support forum.

sections.installation:
Minimum Requirements:

PHP 7.4+ (PHP 7.4 recommended)
MySQL 5.7+, OR MariaDB 10.4+
Refer to official WordPress requirements for a detailed server requirement list.

Automatic installation

For a hassle-free setup, use the automatic installation. WordPress handles the file transfer. Simply:

  1. Log into your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Head to the Plugins menu and select “Add New.”
  3. Search for “WPMozo Product Grid for WooCommerce”.
  4. Click “Install Now” and WordPress oversees the setup.

Manual installation

For a hands-on approach, download the WPMozo Product Grid for WooCommerce plugin, and upload it to your server using your chosen FTP tool. For a step-by-step guide, consult the WordPress codex on manual plugin setup.

Updating

Always back up your website before applying updates. If you experience any display issues after updating, try flushing the permalinks: WordPress > Settings > Permalinks > Save Changes..
sections.faq:
Can I customize the Gutenberg product grid for WooCommerce?

Yes! The WPMozo Gutenberg product grid for WooCommerce provides extensive customization options. You can change grid columns, spacing, and layout styles to fit seamlessly into your WordPress theme.

Does the plugin adapt to variable products?

Yes! WPMozo Product Grid for WooCommerce supports simple and variable products.

Is the plugin mobile-responsive?

Yes! The WPMozo Product Grid for WooCommerce boasts a fluid design, adapting to diverse screen dimensions, ensuring a seamless user experience on all devices.

Is the plugin compatible with other WooCommerce extensions?

We prioritize extensive compatibility. However, specific anomalies might occur. If you encounter any issues, our support team is ready to help.
